reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the rendered redline is identical to the original paragraphs with no comment, which is exactly what is expected for a compliant finding.

The cited fee provisions (Section 4.1, Exhibit B license fees, revenue-share) impose only fixed negotiated payment obligations on Corio (our party) with no undertaking to extend better third-party terms to Commerce One and no matching mechanic, so the clause sits at the playbook's preferred position (no MFN burdening Customer).

Rationale accurately reflects the direction test in the detection guidance (identify the beneficiary; only flag when Customer must give Vendor no-less-favourable terms) and correctly declines to redline; redacted pricing figures do not create an MFN mechanic.
No deterministic check failures and no over-reach: nothing was flagged that benefits our party, and no negotiation issue is raised.
